def triangle_area(a, b, c):

# Unit test for function triangle_area
def test_triangle_area():
    # Valid right triangle (3-4-5) with different argument orderings
    assert triangle_area(3, 4, 5) == 6.0
    assert triangle_area(4, 5, 3) == 6.0
    assert triangle_area(5, 3, 4) == 6.0

    # Equilateral triangles
    assert triangle_area(1, 1, 1) == 0.43    # sqrt(3)/4 ≈ 0.4330
    assert triangle_area(2, 2, 2) == 1.73    # sqrt(3) ≈ 1.7321

    # Isosceles triangle
    assert triangle_area(2, 2, 3) == 1.98    # sqrt(3.9375) ≈ 1.9843

    # Scalene triangle
    assert triangle_area(4, 6, 8) == 11.62   # sqrt(135) ≈ 11.6189

    assert triangle_area(5, 12, 13) == 30.0
